title: Original look font
description: ui/fonts/original_look.yaml of the game pack: the font family for text with the original's look, drawn with the original's bitmap font or a modern font as the player's text_font setting picks (docs/architecture/ui.md).

default.description: The choice before the player makes one.

modern.description: The family of a font under ui/fonts/ that the modern choice draws with; it also draws the characters the bitmap font lacks.

atlas.description: Asset id of the bitmap font's atlas (font/main.png, written by dwx extract). It must live under font/: the game reads its exact pixels, so dwx cook keeps the images there as PNG.

meta.description: Asset id of the atlas's glyphs (font/main_meta.yaml).

baseline.description: The row under the capitals, from the top of a cell.

fallback_size.description: Size of the modern font that draws missing characters, as a fraction of the bitmap font's line height.
